data.summary: Payments, Operations, and Control Governance Professional with 8+ years of experience across global payment operations, settlements, loan servicing, and financial controls. Experienced in managing end-to-end transaction lifecycles including SWIFT, wire transfers, trade loans, and other high-value financial activities, with strong capabilities in transaction review, exception management, compliance oversight, and process accuracy. Demonstrated success in strengthening operational controls, improving efficiency, supporting global stakeholders, and ensuring timely execution in high-volume, risk-sensitive environments. Skilled in mentoring team members, managing workflow delegation, and supporting performance tracking while maintaining strong adherence to operational and regulatory standards.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Wells Fargo - AVP Control Management Specialist
Feb 2024 - Oct 2025
Tracking and documentation of issues and corrective actions, assisting in follow-ups to ensure timely closure. Participated in risk and control validation activities during annual RAU refresh cycles alongside RAU and IRM
teams.
Preparation of reports summarising issue statuses for leadership reviews. Document monthly updates on enterprise-wide issues and corrective actions, ensuring timely reporting and
closure.
Prepare weekly reports highlighting key insights on active issues and corrective actions for leadership across
departments.
Create monthly presentations summarising internal audit, regulatory, and control testing updates for Line of
Business leaders.
CSC Global (Intertrust Group) - Senior Associate II
Mar 2021 - Feb 2024
Led end-to-end migration of payment processes from Luxembourg and Denmark to India, ensuring seamless
transition with zero disruption.
Managed invoice payments, dividend distributions, and investment transactions, collaborating with accountants,
company secretaries, and legal teams to ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance.
Developed MIS dashboards and settlement trackers to enhance visibility of cash positions, unmatched
transactions, and team performance.
Standardised SOPs and built an automated response tracking and allocation file, improving turnaround time and
process consistency.
Responsible for preparing and presenting comprehensive weekly and monthly productivity reports for the team. Oversee daily task delegation and review all payment transactions prepared by the team to maintain accuracy
and compliance.
Coordinated with cross-regional stakeholders across finance, operations, and compliance teams to ensure
timely settlement of payments and resolution of operational issues.
State Street Corporation - Associate II
Mar 2019 - Jul 2019
Monitored client overdrafts daily, ensuring timely identification, exception management, and mitigation of cash
shortfalls.
Prepared and delivered overdraft reports to clients, enhancing transparency and strengthening client
communication. Investigated root causes of overdrafts and coordinated fee recovery, improving accuracy and efficiency in claims processing.
Maintained systematic overdraft records in Citrix, ensuring accurate tracking, reconciliation, and timely
resolution.
JP Morgan Chase & Co - Operations Analyst
Jun 2015 - Mar 2019
Allocated and prioritised high-volume payment and loan queues for a 10-member team, improving TAT by 15%
during peak periods.
Authorised critical payment messages, including MT103, MT202, CHATS, FX and DDA payments, ensuring accuracy
and timeliness.
Managed end-to-end operational processing for trade loans, export financing, and related loan products,
ensuring timely and accurate execution of transactions.
Reviewed and processed loan documentation and settlement instructions, validating transaction details and
ensuring adherence to internal controls and procedures.
Supported loan lifecycle event processing including drawdowns, rollovers, pay-downs, rate resets, and other
event-driven updates based on deal terms and client instructions. Issued timely maturity advices to clients, ensuring accurate communication and smooth processing of loan maturity events.
Prepared monthly payment reports in accordance with client instructions, supporting transparent financial
tracking.
Diligently handled client queries, providing prompt and accurate responses to maintain client satisfaction. Maintained regular communication with internal stakeholders and client services to facilitate smooth payment
operations.
Trained the entire Manila team during the process migration, ensuring smooth transition and knowledge transfer. Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new applications alongside regular BAU activities.
